row.notes: myteam-g1: View-model update for the department morale badge: gets the team modifier list for the department (vm+0x20 dept id, team vm+0x28, map +0xc90 via Career_Get_TeamModifiers), sums modifier values (float at +4), picks lng_high_morale (>0), lng_low_morale (<0) or lng_normal_morale, formats morale_percent_str (abs value) and sets is_morale_relevant / morale_state. Morale = sum of team modifiers filtered by department.

verify.notes: V8995 Modifier list from team+0xc90 via FUN_1434fb4b0, filters entries of kind 0x0d for dept byte vm+0x20, sums float at +4, selects the three loc keys. Matches.
